$comment: genesis-ui ↔ genesis-ui-native parity (scripts/check-ui-parity.mjs). A twin is X ↔ NativeX, or the same name; list the others in twins. Every component without a twin needs a reason: why it's platform-shaped, or `notYet:` and what's missing. Remove an entry once a twin exists: the check fails on stale ones.

webOnly.AccessibleIcon: React Native names an icon with accessibilityLabel on the icon itself.
webOnly.AlertDialog: A phone confirms with the system alert (Alert.alert), which NativeResourceView and NativeRecordView already use.
webOnly.AppShell: The desktop shell (sidebar, header, chat dock) and its layout options (navigation style, frame, density; ADR 0022). A phone's shell is the app's own tab and stack navigators (expo-router); zones work on both through genesis-core's resolveNavigationZones, and native zone shells (ADR 0003 §5) aren't built.
webOnly.AspectRatio: React Native has an aspectRatio style.
webOnly.Band: A genesis-sites section band for marketing pages, which apps don't ship on a phone.
webOnly.BuilderLayout: A desktop builder with side panels and a canvas; there's no phone builder.
webOnly.Breadcrumb: A phone's back button and stack titles do this job.
webOnly.ButtonGroup: notYet: joined buttons; a phone uses NativeSegmentedControl or separate NativeButtons today.
webOnly.Calendar: notYet: a month grid picker; a phone picks dates with NativeDatePicker.
webOnly.Carousel: notYet: a phone pages photos with NativeLightbox; a general paged carousel isn't built.
webOnly.ChartContainer: notYet: charts on the phone aren't built.
webOnly.Collapsible: NativeAccordion covers a phone's collapsible sections.
webOnly.Command: A keyboard-driven command list for pointer-and-keyboard screens; a phone searches with NativeSearchBar or NativeCombobox.
webOnly.ConfirmDeleteDialog: A phone confirms a delete with the system alert, as NativeResourceView does.
webOnly.CustomView: notYet: the native custom view (custom-views' native platform is planned); the headless view hooks are web for now, groupRows is platform-neutral.
webOnly.DashboardPage: notYet: a phone dashboard page isn't built; apps compose NativeHeaderCard and NativeListItem.
webOnly.DataGrid: ResourcePage's grid/list switch; NativeResourceView draws rows and cards itself.
webOnly.DataList: ResourcePage's list view; NativeResourceView's rows are the phone's.
webOnly.DataTable: Tables don't fit a phone; NativeResourceView shows the same view as rows.
webOnly.DefaultLink: The web's link component for app routing; a phone navigates with expo-router.
webOnly.DetailPage: notYet: a phone detail page shell; NativeRecordView covers records.
webOnly.DocumentPage: notYet: a phone document page (cover, icon, title, reading column); a phone composes it from NativeHeaderCard and ScreenContainer until it's built.
webOnly.Display: A genesis-sites display heading for marketing pages.
webOnly.FieldArrayRenderer: notYet: repeating field groups in a phone form.
webOnly.FileUploadField: notYet: a phone form field that picks and uploads files.
webOnly.FilterCombobox: A desktop filter control; NativeDataFilters is the phone's.
webOnly.FollowUpList: notYet: the responses follow-up list on a phone.
webOnly.FormField: The web form's label, control and error wrapper; NativeResourceFormFieldRenderer lays out a phone form field.
webOnly.FormPage: notYet: a phone page for a long form; NativeResourceFormSheet covers record forms.
webOnly.HeadlineNumbers: notYet: the responses headline numbers on a phone.
webOnly.InputGroup: notYet: an input with attached addons on a phone.
webOnly.InputOTP: notYet: a one-time-code input on a phone (iOS fills codes into a plain NativeInput).
webOnly.Kbd: Keyboard key hints are for hardware keyboards.
webOnly.KanbanBoard: notYet: the native board (resource-view-board's native platform is planned).
webOnly.LinkCell: A table cell formatter; phone rows draw links through the view's display renderers.
webOnly.NavigationMenu: A desktop site navigation menu; a phone uses its tab and stack navigators.
webOnly.NoFeaturesFound: notYet: a preset of EmptyState for the features page; a phone passes the same words to NativeEmptyState.
webOnly.NoFeedbackFound: notYet: a preset of EmptyState for the feedback page; a phone passes the same words to NativeEmptyState.
webOnly.NoSearchResults: notYet: a preset of EmptyState for search; a phone passes the same words to NativeEmptyState.
webOnly.PageHeader: A desktop page header; a phone's title and actions sit in the stack header (getNativeRecordViewStackOptions).
webOnly.PasswordToggleField: notYet: NativeInput takes secureTextEntry, but there's no show/hide toggle control.
webOnly.PublicPage: A public marketing-page frame, which apps don't ship on a phone.
webOnly.RecordPeek: notYet: a record page in a native sheet drawing NativeRecordView (record-pages' native platform is planned); NativeResourceView's row press opens its own peek today.
webOnly.ReadinessChip: notYet: RecordView's readiness chip; NativeRecordView draws readiness inline today.
webOnly.RelationField: notYet: a phone form's link field as its own export (NativeResourceView's form uses NativeLinkPicker inside).
webOnly.ResizablePanelGroup: Drag-to-resize panes are a desktop layout.
webOnly.ResourceBoard: notYet: the native board (resource-view-board's native platform is planned).
webOnly.ResourceDetailPage: A desktop record page from a resource; NativeRecordView is the phone's record screen.
webOnly.ResourceHeader: A desktop record header; a phone's record title and actions sit in the stack header.
webOnly.ResourceSettingsPage: notYet: a record's settings page on a phone; NativeRecordView's settings section covers it.
webOnly.ResponsesToolbar: notYet: the responses toolbar on a phone.
webOnly.ScrollArea: Custom-styled scrollbars are a desktop concern; a phone scrolls natively.
webOnly.Section: A genesis-sites page section for marketing pages.
webOnly.SortableList: notYet: drag to reorder on a phone list.
webOnly.Spinner: An inline spinner; a phone uses ActivityIndicator, or NativeLoadingState for a screen.
webOnly.StatCard: notYet: a stat tile on a phone.
webOnly.StatusBadge: notYet: a status badge with its tone from a value; a phone uses NativeBadge with a variant.
webOnly.SubNavTabs: A desktop page's sub-navigation; a phone uses NativeTabs or a stack.
webOnly.SummaryCard: notYet: the responses summary card on a phone.
webOnly.Table: Tables don't fit a phone; lists use NativeListItem rows.
webOnly.ThumbnailCell: A table cell formatter; phone rows draw a picture through the view's row picture.
webOnly.Toaster: The web's toast host; on a phone, NativeToastProvider hosts toasts (a provider, so not counted as a component).
webOnly.ToggleRow: notYet: a settings row with a switch; a phone composes NativeListItem and NativeSwitch.
webOnly.SettingsRow: notYet: a settings row; a phone uses NativeListItem.
webOnly.Toolbar: A desktop toolbar of grouped controls.
webOnly.TreeIndent: A table's tree indentation; tree mode isn't on the phone list.
webOnly.UserAvatar: notYet: an avatar from a user record; a phone uses NativeAvatar with the user's picture.
webOnly.ViewSettings: The desktop list's density and column settings; NativeResourceView has none.
webOnly.ViewToggle: The desktop list's table/grid/list switch; a phone sets NativeResourceView's mode.
webOnly.VisuallyHidden: React Native has no hidden-but-read text; accessibilityLabel does the job.
webOnly.WizardForm: notYet: a multi-step form on a phone.
webOnly.WorkspaceSwitcher: notYet: switching workspace on a phone (the web's sits in the desktop shell).

nativeOnly.AppleSignInButton: Sign in with Apple's native button (expo-apple-authentication); the web's AuthForm draws its social buttons.
nativeOnly.AuthBranding: A part of AuthScreen; the web's AuthPage takes the same fields as its branding block.
nativeOnly.InboxPage: The web inbox is genesis-chat's (packages/chat/src/web/inbox.tsx), not a genesis-ui layout.
nativeOnly.NativeBanner: notYet: a full-width system banner; the web uses Alert.
nativeOnly.NativeChoiceCard: notYet: a selectable option card (radio or checkbox with media); the web form draws its own choice options, and a ChoiceCard export would be the twin.
nativeOnly.NativeChipGroup: notYet: a group of selectable chips; the web lays out Chips itself.
nativeOnly.NativeCombobox: notYet: the web builds a combobox from Command in a Popover; a Combobox export would be the twin.
nativeOnly.NativeSwipeRow: A swipe is a touch gesture; the web's InboxPage puts a row's swipeActions in a More menu.
nativeOnly.NativeFullScreenModal: A phone's full-screen modal (React Native Modal); the web uses Dialog or Lightbox.
nativeOnly.NativeGlassSurface: iOS's glass material; the web has no equivalent.
nativeOnly.NativeHeaderCard: A card with title, body and footer slots as one; the web composes Card with CardHeader and CardFooter.
nativeOnly.NativeIcon: Icons on the web are lucide-react components used directly.
nativeOnly.NativeImage: An image with a placeholder and caching (expo-image); the web uses .
nativeOnly.NativeInlineAlert: notYet: the web's Alert covers both inline and page messages.
nativeOnly.NativeListItem: The phone's list row; the web's lists are DataList and DataTable rows.
nativeOnly.NativeNumberInput: notYet: a number field with steppers; the web uses Input type=number.
nativeOnly.NativeRangeSlider: notYet: a two-thumb range slider on the web (its Slider draws one thumb).
nativeOnly.NativeRefreshControl: Pull to refresh is a phone gesture.
nativeOnly.NativeResourceFormSheet: NativeResourceView's form in a sheet; the web's ResourceForm takes formLayout="sheet".
nativeOnly.NativeSearchBar: The iOS-style search bar with cancel; the web's lists search through DataFilters.
nativeOnly.NativeSectionListHeader: A SectionList's sticky header; the web's grouped lists draw their own.
nativeOnly.NativeStepper: notYet: a plus/minus stepper on the web.
nativeOnly.NativeText: The web's typography is Tailwind classes on elements, not a Text component.
nativeOnly.NativeThreadList: The web's thread list is genesis-chat's inbox (packages/chat/src/web/inbox.tsx).
nativeOnly.NativeTimePicker: notYet: the web picks times with Input type=time.
nativeOnly.NativeZoomablePhoto: Pinch to zoom inside NativeLightbox; the web's Lightbox zooms with the pointer.
nativeOnly.NotificationsPage: notYet: a notifications page on the web.
nativeOnly.ScreenContainer: A phone screen's safe areas and keyboard handling; the web's pages don't need them.
nativeOnly.SettingsSubPage: A pushed settings screen in a stack; the web's SettingsPage shows sections on one page.
nativeOnly.SocialAuthRow: A part of AuthScreen; the web's AuthForm draws its social row.
nativeOnly.ThreadPage: The web thread is genesis-chat's (packages/chat/src/web/thread.tsx), not a genesis-ui layout.
nativeOnly.NativeWhatsNewSheet: notYet: a release's What's new sheet on the phone; the web has no What's new dialog yet.
